subject: AI in banking, week 39: 28 named use cases, 5 agentic live, 6 agentic in pilot
html:
12 of 28 named use cases in these two weeks are already running.
 

Synpulse · AI Banking Tracker

Weekly brief, 12 Sep to 25 Sep 2026

This week in brief

 
Deutsche Bank is the only Tier 1 bank with agents in production this fortnight, running them on source-of-wealth checks in its private bank.
 
Most of the 6 agentic pilots were payments: Danske Bank and Rogers Bank each completed an agent-made transaction with Mastercard, and GoCardless used an agent to move real money.
 
Among Tier 2 banks, KB Kookmin Bank put a conversational assistant live for search, inquiries and transfers, and Bank of Baroda's app launch drew 7 reports.
 
Regulators are adopting AI themselves: the Monetary Authority of Singapore is testing models that spot scam accounts, and the Bank of Thailand plans to audit 3,600 lenders with it.

Written with AI from the reviewed use cases below, and checked before sending.

12 of 28 named use cases in these two weeks are already running.

message: 12 of 28 named use cases in these two weeks are already running.

sentences.text: Deutsche Bank is the only Tier 1 bank with agents in production this fortnight, running them on source-of-wealth checks in its private bank.
Most of the 6 agentic pilots were payments: Danske Bank and Rogers Bank each completed an agent-made transaction with Mastercard, and GoCardless used an agent to move real money.
Among Tier 2 banks, KB Kookmin Bank put a conversational assistant live for search, inquiries and transfers, and Bank of Baroda's app launch drew 7 reports.
Regulators are adopting AI themselves: the Monetary Authority of Singapore is testing models that spot scam accounts, and the Bank of Thailand plans to audit 3,600 lenders with it.
